title: Sarvalokaana – Shor Duniya Mein – Manoj David Telugu Christian Lyrics

credits.Translation & Vocals: Manoj David featuring Anusha David & JCHSIM Church Choir

intro: Sarvalokaana is the latest Telugu Christian song translated from the original song, Shor Duniya Mein (Hindi) written by unknown artist, composed and sung by Sheldon Bangera. This song was translated & sung by Manoj David featuring Anusha David & JCHSIM Church Choir, music composed by Nikhil Paul and released on November 23, 2025 through Manoj David YouTube channel.
